extracted.name: Marshmallow Icing
extracted.description: You’ll melt marshmallows in a double boiler on your way to making this great icing recipe and be glad you did it, too.
instruction_lines: Put egg whites, sugar, water and syrup in top of double boiler. Beat until mixed well. Place over rapidly boiling water. Beat constantly with electric beater while it cooks for 7 minutes or until it will stand in peaks when beater is raised. Remove from heat.
Stir in marshmallows and vanilla. Beat until they melt.
